briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent capabilities amid rising safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid model releases with o4 and R2 pushing reasoning frontiers. Global funding remains elevated as compute constraints intensify. Regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agent deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration. DeepSeek R2 matches performance at lower inference cost. Anthropic and Google prepare Claude 4 and Gemini 3 for August launches.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell racks to xAI Memphis cluster. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU data centers in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports sustained AI chip demand through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems by end of 2026?
